title: vl04: 'isometric operators are automatically normal only in the finite-dimensional case' is imprecise

legacy.old_text: isometrische sind erst im endlich-dimensionalen Fall automatisch normal
legacy.new_text: in endlicher Dimension ist jede Isometrie unitär ... Isometrien sind normal
legacy.applied_text: In endlicher Dimension ist jede Isometrie unitär

legacy.old_text: isometric ones are automatically normal only in the finite-dimensional case
legacy.new_text: in finite dimension every isometry is unitary ... isometries are normal
legacy.applied_text: In finite dimension every isometry is unitary

reason: The reason is not stated: in finite dimension an isometry V (V^dagger V = I) is injective, hence bijective, hence unitary, hence normal. In infinite dimension an isometry need not be normal (the right shift on l^2 is an isometry with S S^dagger != S^dagger S). The new text gives the reason (isometry = unitary in finite dimension, line 56) and the lecture's finite-dimension hypothesis (line 17). The old line also uses a dash '---' in prose.
